Plus: FIFA paid its president Gianni Infantino a second salary which was not publicly declared; EFL and Premier League closer to agreeing new financial solidarity package after years of talks; Rugby chiefs will look to avoid a Manchester City-style scandal by drawing up strict new rules

The top stories and transfer rumours from Tuesday's newspapers...

FIFA paid millions of dollars to Gianni Infantino on top of his standard salary and bonus, but did not publicly declare the payments in an alleged violation of its own statutes - Times

Erling Haaland and his father Alf-Inge have each bought a property on a luxury Manchester City housing development in Abu Dhabi - Times

The English Football League (EFL) and Premier League are now only £27m apart from agreeing a comprehensive new financial solidarity package for the men's game after years of stop-start talks - Athletic

Rugby chiefs will look to avoid a Manchester City-style scandal in the English game by drawing up strict new rules that include restrictions on foreign-state ownership of clubs - Telegraph

Real Madrid goalkeeper Thibaut Courtois is set to extend his contract by a further 12 months through to the summer of 2028 - Athletic
